verdict.rationale: Devin's conversational UI and IDE handoff ('follow and take over Devin's development process in the embedded IDE') implies users can interject during an active session, and features like Interactive Browser and terminal viewing suggest mid-task steering; however, no doc explicitly describes sending follow-up chat instructions to steer an already-running session without restart. missing for 10: explicit documentation of mid-session follow-up messaging/steering, independent hands-on confirmation that new instructions are incorporated without restarting the task.
